title: Document aggregation API behavior and boundaries
description: Document the new public aggregation API and helper behavior in source-level documentation so downstream shopping-list features inherit the intended scope and non-goals.
acceptance_criteria: Public doc comments on the aggregation types and `ShoppingList.aggregate` clearly describe canonicalisation, nil `Other` aisle semantics, stable ordering, and quantity-merging boundaries.
`AisleConfig.canonical(for:)` is documented as alias-aware canonical lookup returning `nil` when unmatched.
Documentation explicitly avoids implying unit conversion, markdown formatting, note preservation, or UI responsibilities.
The shared documentation bead depends on every developer bead in the feature tree.
